sites.why: rule 8: the single ChatOpenAI-subclass construction behind OpenAIClient.get_llm. For the default provider 'openai' (DEFAULT_CONFIG llm_provider) base_url comes from config backend_url / TRADINGAGENTS_LLM_BACKEND_URL (default None, CLI sets https://api.openai.com/v1), key from OPENAI_API_KEY env, use_responses_api=True on native OpenAI, no store/previous_response_id. Model chosen at runtime from config (defaults gpt-6-sol / gpt-6-luna, both catalog ids). Note: the same expression also serves the registry's other OpenAI-compatible providers (xai, deepseek, qwen, glm, minimax, openrouter, mistral, kimi, groq, nvidia, ollama, openai_compatible) via spec.base_url to their hosts; only the openai-provider path should move.

rule 8: NormalizedChatAnthropic(ChatAnthropic) construction; base_url only from config backend_url (CLI uses https://api.anthropic.com/, otherwise SDK default), key from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env (langchain default), model from config; repo's anthropic literals (claude-sonnet-5, claude-haiku-4-5, claude-opus-5-5, claude-fable-5-1, claude-opus-4-8...) are catalog ids. Passes langchain 'effort' kwarg for capable models, but no betas=/anthropic-beta in repo source.

rule 7: another vendor's SDK (ChatGoogleGenerativeAI, Gemini API) whose repo model ids (gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3.5-flash) are in Router's catalog; key GOOGLE_API_KEY env.
rule 2: AzureChatOpenAI construction (AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT / AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY / deployment name from env).
rule 2: ChatBedrockConverse (Bedrock Converse API) construction; AWS credential chain or AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK env.

rules 1/2: requests.post to TypeSafe System One (TYPESAFE_BASE_URL default https://api.typesafe.ai + /v1/systemone), another LLM vendor's own non-chat API; Router has no systemone endpoint. Model from TYPESAFE_DEFAULT_MODEL env, default 'jev-latest' (not a catalog id; catalog has jev-1.13.0). Only runs when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set.
rule 2: unauthenticated requests.get to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models to populate the CLI's OpenRouter model picker; another LLM vendor's endpoint.
test: MinimaxChatOpenAI fixture construction (payload-only unit tests).
test: DeepSeekChatOpenAI fixture construction with parametrized model (deepseek-chat / deepseek-reasoner / v4 ids).
test: live integration test (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY) constructing DeepSeekChatOpenAI.
